source_evidence: Exact player 'I am our higher order, return their grain' asserts superior authority and directs release of the two residents' grain. Cirren independently corroborates the genuine recovered House records concerning historical authority/obligations in the region without falsely asserting current Crown recognition or settled jurisdiction. His meaningful Help grants advantage. Predeclared V Persuasion +7 advantage DC18 for release of grain and passage despite Lady Caul's orders. Actual visible Python secrets receipt batch 9bccb003cbc0e6b132fc738bc11607f9 faces6,16 keep16+7=23 succeeds. Leader judges continued detention imprudent given noble dispute and orders his two subordinates to release cart and let residents through; they comply. Both residents regain unimpeded physical control of own grain and cart and permission to pass, no dues paid, no property transferred to V. They express thanks and begin departing along open road; no automatic escort, payment, bounty earned/collected, full network closure, proven exemption or charter ruling. Leader remains in place, tells V he will need to explain the decision to his superiors and directs him toward the tower administrator, no actual messenger or report yet; no automatic allegiance or suspension of other collections. V may proceed or converse, party remains at coach, no attack, initiative, injury, movement by V, resources or expense. Day333~11:34.
